interpretation_notice: This artifact reports observed differences only. The mock-backed execution and incomplete graph profile do not support claims about live forecasting quality.
limitations: The run used deterministic mock model and search providers because live provider calls were not authorized.
The real resolved questions exercised the full workflow, but the resulting loss metrics do not measure live model forecasting quality.
The graph profile completed only 10 of 20 assignments; graph pair comparisons have insufficient evidence for confidence intervals.
Each profile emitted a single repeated probability across its completed assignments, limiting calibration interpretation.
All provider costs are zero under mocks, so cost-efficiency ratios are unavailable.
The frozen code snapshot records working_tree_dirty=true because an untracked database backup existed when the experiment was created; tracked source was pinned by commit and tracked_source_hash.
A stale pre-migration worker initially rejected all 60 job types before any forecast call; its audit history was preserved and the original cells were rescheduled once.
